_meta.description: 200 response for POST /api/tesla/vehicles/{vehicleId}/refresh (rest-api.md §7.15, MYR-315) — the WOKE-AND-READ outcome. The vehicle was asleep, the server spent part of its wake budget, brought it up and performed a one-shot read; lastUpdated is that new read. Carries fractional seconds deliberately: the backend emits both RFC3339 shapes, and a client that only parses the non-fractional one silently loses the timestamp on exactly this path. The refreshed STATE is not in this body — the client re-fetches §7.1 to get it.
